description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating various message producers and consumers related to the Thingsboard core queue system, including methods for handling transport, rule engine, core, usage stats, OTA updates, version control, housekeeper, edge, calculated fields, and job stats messaging.

classes.name: TbCoreQueueFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating message producers and consumers for various core queue topics in Thingsboard.

methods.name: createTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for transport service messages.

methods.name: createRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for rule engine messages.

methods.name: createRuleEngineNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for rule engine notification messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for core messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for core notification messages.

methods.name: createToCoreMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for core messages.

methods.name: createToUsageStatsServiceMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for usage stats messages.

methods.name: createToOtaPackageStateServiceMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for OTA package state messages.

methods.name: createToOtaPackageStateServiceMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for OTA package state messages.

methods.name: createToCoreNotificationsMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for core notification messages.

methods.name: createTransportApiRequestConsumer

methods.name: createTransportApiResponseProducer

methods.name: createRemoteJsRequestTemplate

methods.name: createVersionControlMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for version control messages.

methods.name: createHousekeeperReprocessingMsgProducer

methods.name: createHousekeeperReprocessingMsgConsumer
